_README: Hand-maintained corrections for the film index. enrich.py reads this and never writes it,
and an entry here always beats a TMDB lookup — so re-running enrich.py can never revert
a correction made here. Keys are matched case- and accent-insensitively.
"some title": { "tmdb": 12345 }                 pin to a TMDB movie id
"some title": { "title": "Correct Title" }      fix the display title only
"some title": { "kind": "tv" }                  television, held out of the film index
Fix typos HERE with "title", not in the EPISODES array: the chapter VTTs on R2 were
written from the original spelling, and rewriting EPISODES would break the listen links.
Add "note" to any entry to record why.

The Chair.note: Netflix series with Sandra Oh; TMDB search wrongly matched a 2022 horror film of the same name

Vigil.note: BBC series; TMDB search wrongly matched a 2022 short

Morning Wars.note: AU title for The Morning Show
